channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions
channel.description: Utrecht city council decisions and documents explained in plain language.

item.title: Adoption of Result Allocation 2025
item.description: The council has adopted the Result Allocation 2025. The decision regulates carrying over 20.5 million euros in remaining incidental budgets to the 2026 budget year to complete ongoing projects.

item.title: Adoption of Annual Accounts 2025
item.description: The council has adopted the Annual Accounts 2025 and granted discharge to the college. The year ends with a surplus of 54.6 million euros added to the general coverage reserve.

item.title: Adoption of Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026
item.description: The Gemeenteraad has adopted the Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026. The decision includes programming investments in affordable housing, sustainable mobility, green spaces, and allocating preparation credits for redevelopments.

item.title: Adoption of First Management Report 2026
item.description: The council has adopted the First Management Report 2026. This increases investment credits by 26.2 million euros and implements shifts in the social domain.

item.title: Adoption of Spring Memorandum 2026
item.description: The council has adopted the policy-neutral Spring Memorandum 2026. The decision confirms the updated financial picture with unavoidable bottlenecks as the basis for the new coalition agreement.

item.title: Exemption of residence requirement
item.description: The city council discusses a proposal to exempt the residence requirement for aldermen.

item.title: Appointment of Aldermen
item.description: The city council discusses the appointment of new aldermen.

item.title: Audit report on household help
item.description: The Rekenkamer investigated household help services in Utrecht. The report 'Stof tot nadenken' contains seven recommendations to improve services. The council is asked to request the municipal executive to implement these recommendations.

item.title: Adopt Wmo Regulation 2027
item.description: The council is deciding on the new Verordening maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2027. The rules become clearer and more accessible for residents and professionals. Clear criteria and new rules for the own contribution are introduced.

item.title: Amendment to Participatiewet re-integration ordinance
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is updating the Verordening re-integratie en tegenprestatie Participatiewet. This provides young people up to 27 with better support from school to work and introduces a new Ontwikkeltraject.

item.title: Amendment General Local Regulation
item.description: The city council is proposing an amendment to the General Local Regulation (APV).

item.title: Governance change for BghU tax cooperation
item.description: The college requests permission from the Gemeenteraad to amend the Gemeenschappelijke Regeling BghU. This changes BghU from an operational organization into a public body with an Algemeen Bestuur and Dagelijks Bestuur.

item.title: Environmental plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is deciding on the TAM environmental plan for Jan van Galenstraat, Huizingalaan, and Van Ginnekenlaan. This enables the construction of 102 rental homes, a supermarket, retail units, and an underground parking garage.

item.title: Adjustment to registration duration extension for priority groups
item.description: The college is adjusting the flex-housing experiment framework for residents of Place2BU and Goeie Buur. Registration duration extension will now be variably determined based on allocation figures to enable moving to a new home.

item.title: Environmental plan update Pijlsweerd, Lauwerecht, Vogelenbuurt, Tuinwijk
item.description: The council is adopting the second amendment to the Utrecht environmental plan. This converts ten zoning plans in Noordwest and Noordoost into the definitive environmental plan and adds rules on soil quality and archaeology.

item.title: Declaration of no objection expansion Theo Pouw Isotopenweg
item.description: The college proposes that the council issue a specific declaration of no objection for Theo Pouw at Isotopenweg 29. This enables the Province of Utrecht to grant a permit for two new waste processing activities.

item.title: Disclosure of confidential annexes on Klépierre damage compensation
item.description: This initiative proposal aims to have the council decide to lift the confidentiality of the annexes to the agreement with Klépierre regarding the stairs of the Moreelsebrug and make them public.

item.title: Answers to council questions and financial document errata
item.description: The college sends responses to written questions regarding the Annual Accounts 2025 and management reports, including errata. The letter also contains a call from G4 cities regarding animal welfare and vet costs.
